title: Here's Why Middleby Stock Is an Opportunity After This Week's Drop
author: Howard Smith
description: Middleby stock dropped 12.3% following its first earnings report after spinning off its food processing unit on July 6. The company is now a pure-play commercial foodservice business with simplified operations and newly raised guidance projecting 6-8% sales growth. With an implied P/E ratio under 17.5, analysts view the post-spin-off decline as a buying opportunity.
